name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars
storyline:
Italian Campaign

In 1796, the young General Napoleon takes command of the French Army of Italy — outnumbered and short of supplies — and marches against the Austrian and Piedmontese forces holding northern Italy. The campaign unfolds across the rivers, plains, and Alpine passes of the peninsula. Each battle presents its own challenge: forcing river crossings, storming mountain positions, and breaking larger armies through speed and maneuver.

Egyptian Campaign

After the triumph in Italy, Napoleon sets out for Egypt to strike at British influence in the East. The campaign places the French army in entirely new conditions — desert, heat, the Mamluks, and the Ottoman Empire. Every battle reflects a distinct challenge: from urban combat to fortress sieges to field battles against an unfamiliar enemy.
summary: Command history and turn the tides of war in this real-time strategy experience. Quick decisions and keen tactical formations are the only things that stand between your troops and victory during the Napoleonic Wars. A regiment that survives today is your elite force tomorrow.
